description: Install selected skills into Claude Code and/or Codex, pinned to an immutable SHA + hash in skills.lock. Refuses skills the scanner flags as high-risk unless acknowledgeRisk:true. Only ids present in the index can be installed.

acknowledgeRisk.description: Set true to proceed installing skills the scanner flagged as high-risk.

allowOverflow.description: Set true to exceed the installed-skill cap (the cap keeps the agent's context/token use low).

linkMode.description: How to materialize skills. 'auto' picks junction/symlink with copy fallback.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the server's working directory.

skills.description: Skills to install. Only ids present in the index are accepted.

ref.description: Optional branch/tag/sha; resolved to a pinned SHA.

targets.description: Which tools to install into. Omit to auto-detect (.claude / .agents).

name: install_skills
title: Install skills
